parsed.note_claim: Politicians like Boris Johnson and Günter Sautter were on a separate chartered train not hit but stopped nearby as precaution.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Günter Sautter, reiste demnach in der Nacht mit einem privat gecharterten Zug von Kiew nach Polen. Am frühen Morgen sei der Zug dann nahe der polnischen Grenze gestoppt
parsed.reason: The article confirms Sautter and others traveled on a privately chartered train that was stopped near the border due to drones, distinguishing it from the regular passenger train that was attacked.
